answer: The spiral is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the quill. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the juniper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
